android.hc_privacy_notice:
Health Connect activity and health data

With your permission, AuricRX MedCoach will read your heart rate, resting heart rate, steps, and exercise sessions from Health Connect (which may come from Samsung Health, Fitbit, Garmin, Mi Fitness, or other apps). We use them only to show you your history and charts inside the app. We do not make diagnoses. We do not sell this data, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties. It stays on your phone and is not sent to our servers. You can withdraw this permission at any time in Settings > Privacy or in Health Connect, and delete the imported data.

Data imported from your apps and devices for wellness purposes. It may not be accurate. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace a doctor's assessment. If you feel unwell or have symptoms, seek medical care; in an emergency call 911.
